name: rtl-agents
description: Professional RTL/LTR toggle support for AI Chats (Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, VSCodium, Antigravity) with code block alignment safety.
author: Foshati

enumDescriptions: Pin chat text to a right-to-left base. Correct for Persian, Arabic and Hebrew conversations, including sentences that open with an English term.
Let each paragraph pick its direction from its first strong character. Only preferable when the chat is mostly left-to-right with occasional RTL passages.
rtl-agents.baseDirection.markdownDescription:
Base direction for rendered chat text.

`rtl` pins every message block to a right-to-left base. `auto` restores the pre-2.1 per-paragraph detection, which mis-aligns Persian sentences that begin with a Latin term such as `API` or `npm install`.

rtl-agents.customSelectors.description: Additional chat container selectors to enable RTL inside. Text in them follows the same base direction as the built-in containers.

rtl-agents.rtlCharacterRegex.deprecationMessage: Deprecated since v2.0.0. Direction is resolved by the browser, not by scanning characters. See rtl-agents.baseDirection.
